paragraphs.text: Bureaucrat is an acorn and obsolete class used for cards that depict an official in a company or government.

Bureaucrat originally debuted as a legal creature type on Aysen Bureaucrats in Homelands and on the silver-bordered Frazzled Editor in Unglued . It was removed from the Comprehensive Rules during the Grand Creature Type Update with Aysen Bureaucrats becoming an Advisor instead. However, it has continued to see use in subsequent un-sets like Unsanctioned and thus has remained an acorn creature class.
